headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Key Risks- Any regulatory changes affecting derivatives volumes.
BSE Limited delivered consolidated total income reaching INR 1,551 cr, representing a 36.0% YoY increase (-9.2% sequential growth), with revenue from operations standing at INR 1,433 cr (+34.1% YoY).
Operating EBITDA (including Core SGF) climbed to INR 973 cr, up 43.0% YoY, with margins expanding to 67.9% (vs 66.8% in Q1 FY27).

Net profit attributable to shareholders reached INR 809 cr (+44.9% YoY), reflecting a robust 52.2% net margin as the exchange continues to realize significant operating leverage despite inflationary technology spending.
valuation: The current valuations based on our DCF-based target we maintain a HOLD rating with target price of INR 4,468 (27X FY29 P/E), reflecting a 17.6% upside from CMP of INR 3,800.
Management targets reaching a "double-digit market share" in the cash segment by early CY2027, noting that institutional volumes are rising as legacy structural barriers are addressed.
watch: Key Risks- Any regulatory changes affecting derivatives volumes.
Key Performance Drivers Equity Cash Market Share: The exchange recorded quarterly Average Daily Turnover (ADTV) of INR 10,494 cr.
